opportunity: First recorded exposure for each student/problem across all ten logs; repeated assignments do not create new observations.
target: Correctness of the first recorded original response with no recorded help; not latent mastery or misconception.

fit.fallback: pooled fit using training student-skill sequences only
fit.selection: Lowest training negative log likelihood among converged starts; dev is evaluation only in this version.

test_policy: sealed: benchmark command reads train and dev only
